about: Olds is a town in central Alberta on Highway 27, just east of Highway 2 between Calgary and Red Deer. Olds College, a compact downtown, and a role as an agricultural service centre on the parkland prairie define the community. About 9,000 people live in Olds.
seoSummary: Central Alberta town on Highway 27—Olds College and parkland agricultural service centre between Calgary and Red Deer.
